lens.payload: {"score": 8, "findings": [{"file": "core/pipeline/runner.sh", "category": "injection", "severity": "low", "line": null, "message": "_runner_run_id read from the persisted state file via get_state_field is never sanitised before being interpolated into event-bus fields; a crafted state file whose .run_id contains spaces or equals signs would split the event record into extra phantom fields.", "quote": "_runner_run_id=\"$(get_state_field \"$state_file\" '.run_id' \"$(date +%Y%m%d%H%M%S)-$$\")\"", "introduced": false, "fix": "code"}, {"file": "core/pipeline/runner.sh", "category": "injection", "severity": "low", "line": null, "message": "In _runner_from_stage_preflight the variable name built for indirect expansion uses only dash-to-underscore substitution, leaving characters such as ], [, and . intact; bash interprets arrayname[n] syntax inside indirect expansion, so a cycle name containing ] could resolve to a different array element than intended.", "quote": "local _fsp_cycle_csv=\"${!_fsp_cycle_stages_var:-}\"", "introduced": true, "fix": "code"}, {"file": "core/pipeline/runner.sh", "category": "injection", "severity": "low", "line": null, "message": "export _ZBUILD_RESUME_ACTIVE=true makes the engine internal resume flag visible to every child process including plugin run hooks; a plugin that reads this variable can silently alter its behaviour on resume, creating an undocumented side-channel between the engine and plugin code.", "quote": "export _ZBUILD_RESUME_ACTIVE=true", "introduced": true, "fix": "design"}, {"file": "core/state/artifact-persist.sh", "category": "path traversal", "severity": "low", "line": 644, "message": "The guard in _artifact_persist_put_back rejects absolute rel values but does not reject rel paths beginning with ../; a directory containing a symlink whose find output after prefix-stripping starts with .. could bypass the check and write outside the destination tree.", "quote": "[[ \"$rel\" == /* ]] && continue", "introduced": true, "fix": "code"}]}
